questions.title: Conditional Rendering
questions.direct_answer: Conditional Rendering is a core interview concept. Explain its purpose, the problem it solves, its trade-offs, and one small example from real application code.

sections.title: Interview answer
sections.content: Conditional Rendering is a core interview concept. Explain its purpose, the problem it solves, its trade-offs, and one small example from real application code. In a real project, I would use it when it fits the situation and mention one edge case.

sections.title: Concept explained

A good check is a focused test for the normal case, an empty or invalid input, and the largest expected input.
